name: Large Throwing Wheel
ability: After you form a Vase or Censer, gain 1 Clay.

name: Measuring Calipers
ability: After you form two different Shapes during the same Forming action, gain 1 Coin.

name: Clay Substitution
ability: When paying a Forming cost, you may pay 1 Coin instead of 1 Clay.

name: Drying Frames
ability: After you form a ceramic whose Shape matches at least one uncompleted Order in your hand, gain 1 Coin.

name: Carving Knives
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of one Carved Decoration you apply.

name: Seal Stamps
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of one Impressed Decoration you apply.

name: Glaze Notebook
ability: After you apply two different Glazes during the same Glaze action, gain 1 Wood.

name: Colour Samples
ability: After you take an Order, you may discard one other face-up Order from the same display and refill it.

name: Kiln Setting
ability: Before Wood Contributions are chosen, move one of your loaded ceramics to any empty kiln space.

name: Protective Saggars
ability: After Quality is assigned, pay 1 Coin to improve one of your Flawed ceramics to Standard.

name: Fuel Ledger
ability: After Contribution cards are revealed but before Base Heat is determined, pay 1 Coin and spend 1 Wood to increase your contribution by 1.

name: Test Pieces
ability: After firing, gain 1 Coin if at least one of your ceramics had an exact heat match before any ability altered Actual Heat, heat difference or Quality.
